title: Farming
summary: Harvest the Farm, the Barn and the Mushroom Desert for Farming XP, crops and collections; Farming Fortune, the Farm Merchant and farming minions.

s.x: Farming levels by harvesting crops. The Farming skill is Hypixel SkyBlock's: 60 levels, the
Farmhand
perk (+4 Farming Fortune a level, 240 at level 60) and bonus Health every level. See
Skills overview
for the XP curve and what each level pays.
Crops only break in the farming areas, and every crop you harvest grows back after a few seconds.

rows.x: Cactus, Sugar Cane, Cocoa Beans, Red and Brown Mushrooms, Sand
Carrots, in the cave at its foot

s.x: Crops pay XP only when fully grown. The Barn and the Mushroom Desert also hold farm animals (Cows, Pigs, Chickens, Rabbits, Sheep, Mooshrooms); killing them pays Combat XP, not Farming.

rows.x: Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Melon, Sugar Cane, Cactus

s.x: Blocks you placed yourself never pay XP, and neither do minions: only what you harvest with your own hands counts.
What you harvest fills the Farming
collections
: Wheat, Seeds, Carrot, Potato, Pumpkin, Melon Slice, Sugar Cane, Cactus, Cocoa Beans, Mushroom and the rest of the 20. Each tier unlocks recipes in the
Recipe Book
: Wheat I opens the Wheat Minion, and higher tiers open the enchanted forms. Items you collect from your minions count too.

rows.x: Each full 100 drops the crop's items one more time, and the rest is the chance of one more. It works on fully grown crops, Melons, Pumpkins, Sugar Cane, Cactus and Cocoa, not on Mushrooms. The Farmhand perk gives +4 a level.
Wheat Fortune and the other crop fortunes
Listed on gear, but have no effect yet.

s.x: The
Farm Merchant
in Skyhaven and the
Windmill Operator

at the Barn sell the same goods: Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes, Melons, Sugar Cane, Pumpkins, Cocoa Beans, Mushrooms, Sand, Cactus, Enchanted Bone Meal and the Rookie Hoe. Click any crop in your inventory to sell it (see
NPC shops
Jake
, in the Mushroom Desert, trades animal axes.
Farming minions work on your island: Wheat, Carrot, Potato, Pumpkin, Melon, Mushroom, Cactus, Cocoa Beans, Sugar Cane, Nether Wart, Flower and the animal minions. See
Minions
A reforge and Potato Books make a farming tool better: see
Reforging
